## Summary

Describe the user problem and the smallest change that solves it.

## Verification

- [ ] Focused tests pass
- [ ] `pnpm validate` passes
- [ ] Relevant integration or browser tests pass
- [ ] Documentation and OpenAPI inventory are current

## Compatibility

- [ ] Existing data is preserved
- [ ] Migration or update requirements are documented
- [ ] WebsiteSpec and exported-site acceptance remain compatible, or the change is called out explicitly
- [ ] No secrets, customer data, platform code, or unsigned release bypasses are included
